title: [SLS] Update accuracy prompts for GPT-5.6 Ceres migration
summary: Sales Lines Suggestions prompts and accuracy evaluations are updated for GPT-5.6 Ceres migration, with six task and tool prompts now packaged as app resources and semantic judgment replacing keyword matching for product meaning detection.
key_points: Six normal prompts packaged as app resources via NavApp.GetResourceAsText instead of Key Vault secrets
Safety and meta prompts remain in Key Vault for central management
Semantic evaluation with GPT-5.6 Ceres judge replaces keyword/feature matching for product meaning
Whole-message fallback policy: mixed unsupported and supported requests route only to magic_function
Quantities preserved including zero and fractions, datasets updated for routing, extraction and confidence checks
quote: Update Sales Lines Suggestions prompts, quantity handling and accuracy evaluations for the GPT-5.6 Ceres migration.
